why: ThrillhouseBot#1063 review: the #920 evidence-and-claims rule took the names a file's added lines declare as the only evidence of behaviour, so a retry added inside the existing Mailer.send, which declares no new name, read as a behaviour no file shows and became a false description gap. The row now names the changed function ('changes: send'), and a claim about what a changed function does is reported as the description's claim, never as missing.
prTitle: fix(mailer): retry a failed relay hand-off
prDescription: Mailer.send now retries a failed relay hand-off up to three times with exponential backoff before giving up, so a transient relay outage no longer drops the organizer's confirmation.
